Jesse sits by the door re-lacing a strap, testing each pull before the next. They've been meaning to check on their people.

lines.t: 💛 You hold Dog Tags. Not yours. Vy's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Vy would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they have carried you this far. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
💬 Zuri: "Huh. Never been this way before."
You work the patch with practiced hands: 11× Purslane (330 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
While you were gone — one thing you missed:
🩸 The Terms of Service mauled Danna (-64 health) over 4 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — staying out of sight for the rest of the day — too hurt to meet it again
You keep a day's food (330 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
You walk back into Haven. 18 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
💬 Hannah: "Stay close, yeah?"
You clear a dead bed. Sow fresh seed to start a new crop. (40 kcal.)
You sow Purslane: 30 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 28 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
You coax 4 growing beds forward by 12 days. The next harvest carries the growth magic.
(−200 kcal — food becomes green thumb.)
Harvest: 90× Purslane. About 2700 kcal before preparation.
👂 Overheard — Hannah: "We should paint the warning markers. Red means run, yellow means look."
👂 Overheard — Zuri: "Hmm. That fits what I've been seeing. Let me think about the mechanism..."
👂 Zuri "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
(Something in their exchange sticks with you. read people +1)
You eat Purslane (540 kcal).
Your chewing echoes off the trees. Something out there heard. (encounters more likely tomorrow)
📋 Jesse — 🎣 Fish. Jesse nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Danna folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
"Enough," Danna says. "I want a say in how this village runs. A real say."
📋 Leah — 🎣 Fish. Leah nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" Danna doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
📋 Zuri — 🎣 Fish. Zuri nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Hannah — 🍲 Cook. (a natural — good pick) Hannah nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Danna mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
You give Daniyar 3 portions of Purslane, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
You call a moot on it. The fire gets built up. The petitioners sit just outside the light, trying not to look like they're listening.
Zuri stands. "They're starving. That's the whole story. Feed them."
Dale stands. "Hungry mouths don't stop being hungry. They just become our hungry mouths."
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken.
Leah counts on their fingers, twice. Then, to the fire: "4 for taking them in. 5 against."
Zuri exhales. "Good. I hope the road's kinder to them than we were."
The moot votes no. Hana nods like they expected it. "Thanks for the fire, anyway." They walk.
Word later: they walked to The Hungry Road. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Word will travel: Haven is turned away the hungry. Other fires will remember. (Opinion -4 with every village that knows you.)
